newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh expects 20.7 mln tonnes food output.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh expects 20.7 mln tonnes food output.

text.p: Bangladesh expects foodgrain output in 1996/97 (July-June) to reach 20.7 million tonnes, little more than last year, Food Minister Begum Matia Chowdhury said.
The country would still face a shortage of 1.73 million tonnes of grains during the current year, the official BSS news agency quoted her as telling parliament on Thursday.
Chowdhury told a World Food Day seminar in October that Bangladesh was aiming to produce 25 million tonnes of foodgrains annually by the year 2000.
Bangladesh, home to nearly 120 million people, imports up to three million tonnes annually to meet the deficit and to build up an emergency reserve, officials said.
